bounded_question: Can creator-global truth/knowledge inspection and a Character-bounded Julian view operate inside the real COMP shell with source/provenance capacity, hidden-material non-leakage and exact nested return without becoming permanent Knowledge navigation or freezing a final epistemic model?
frozen_inputs: PKT-COMP-04-01 exclusive deep-task and exact-return law
Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted truth/knowledge/disclosure functional and Phase-3 evidence
construction_law: Truth/knowledge/disclosure remains contextual inspection depth reached from meaningful current material, not permanent Knowledge navigation.
Creator-global visibility and Character-bounded visibility are different information positions over the same persistent Production/Character identity.
Julian-bounded presentation may show only Product-supported Julian-visible material; creator-global-only material is not enumerated, counted, summarized, placeholdered or hinted by default.
Unknown != false; withheld/private != absent; claim != fact; memory != objective history; historical status != truth status.
Claim selection and provenance keyboard focus remain independent UI states and do not imply truth authority.
Accent/color may reinforce selection only; it may not encode fact, truth, confidence, private/withheld, source authority or disclosure eligibility.
Entering or leaving a bounded view changes visibility only; it does not duplicate Julian, transfer knowledge or mutate Production truth.
Back from Julian-bounded restores the exact creator-global inspection state/focus; Close from creator-global restores the originating current question and disclosure trigger focus.
mechanical_acceptance: zero missing button accessible names and zero undersized icon-only controls
creator-global task opens in both themes while Shaping is hidden
Claim is selected while Provenance can receive independent keyboard focus
Julian-bounded view contains no visible private/withheld record, count, placeholder or summary hint
bounded-to-global return restores creator-global Claim selection and originating bounded-view trigger focus
global Close restores current-question selection and disclosure trigger focus
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: Darkness may not imply secrecy, boundedness, uncertainty or lesser truth; Light may not imply greater truth/global authority.
Teal may not encode fact/truth/known/confidence/source authority/private/withheld/disclosure eligibility.
Julian-bounded material must look equally real while exposing less information.
Bounded presentation fails if it advertises creator-global-only material through counts, placeholders, redactions, summaries or disabled rows.
Fact/claim/memory/history distinctions must remain structural/textual and survive forced colors.
Narrow sequencing must preserve identity, disclosure boundary and nested exact return.
explicit_non_goals: final epistemic taxonomy, data fields, storage model or truth authority
knowledge transfer, discovery, forgetting, deception or contradiction resolution
Stage successor, production tokens or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Responsive and interaction-plumbing repairs may alter geometry/DOM mechanics only. Any change to accepted disclosure semantics, witness meaning or frozen visual roles requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-07 retuning.
